connectors.name: 2x4 female header (back view)
connectors.orderNote: 2xN without printed numbers; USB not visible in the back view, so started at the top; position 1 = top hole of the left (outer, nearest case edge) column, then alternating right/left down the header

connectors.name: QwiiC-4PIN connector (Type-C end view)
connectors.orderNote: No printed numbers; the Type-C connector sits centred above the Qwiic socket so neither end is nearer USB; started at the left of the image as displayed

uncertain: 2x4 header: the label table and case silkscreen give a 4-row x 2-column grid joined to the header by a single line; mapping each grid cell to the hole in the same position is inferred, not drawn per hole.

Qwiic order: Type-C is centred above the socket so the USB-nearest rule does not pick an end; left-to-right of the end view was used. The back-view case print 'GND +3.3V TX RX' (mirror order) is consistent with this.
notes: Header labels use the callout table spelling (IO03, IO00, 3.3V, IO01, 5V); case silkscreen spellings (IO3, IO0, +3.3V, IO1, +5V) placed first in functions. 2-pin battery connector marked only + / - skipped (rule 1). LCD, touch, PMU I2C, Bat_ADC and LED callouts are internal signals with no physical pins. Qwiic labels taken from the end-view callout only (G kept as printed).
